notes: Only lines that start with exactly [YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ] (UTC) count; any other line is noise, even if it contains a marker, and a // stage closes the most recently opened stage. A stage still open at the end of the log ends at the last timestamped line, and repeated names are separate entries. In Java each entry is a two-element List<Object>, e.g. Arrays.asList(name, seconds) with seconds an int.
